# RewindBox 0.0.11 — Build 721

Everything since RewindBox 0.0.10 (Build 559), brought together in one update.

## 🎮 PlayStation 3 — RPCS3

- **Assassin’s Creed:** audio mixing corrections prevent audio periods from being discarded during waits.
- Reduced redundant rendering interruptions and repeated graphics work, including changes to **Vulkan/MoltenVK**.
- Improved texture caching to reuse more previously calculated results.
- **Black Ops II:** corrections to SPU synchronization, memory reservations and waits involved in stalls.
- **Black Ops II:** earlier submission of pending occlusion results, with a separate bounded budget, targets waits on the game’s main CPU threads.
- Corrected short active-wait timing on iPhones with a 1 GHz system counter and adjusted the BO2 writer-lock wait path.
- **Assassin’s Creed:** corrected an atomic SPU write that could overwrite a newer main-CPU value during game exit.
- Improved SPU program preparation and cache reuse to reduce recompilation during gameplay.
- **God of War III:** removed the unintended 30 FPS limit and reduced unnecessary texture validation.
- **God of War III v1.00:** the optional MLAA bypass now applies on a fresh boot as well.
- **Assassin’s Creed IV and Dynasty Warriors 6:** corrected game profiles to use the LLVM PPU recompiler.
- Corrected texture coherence, partial graphics commands and CPU/GPU synchronization paths.
- More reliable retention of mounted ISO images.
- Corrected JIT memory reservation when the usual address range is unavailable, including on certain iOS beta versions.
- Repositioned the **Menu** and **Performance** buttons to better respect touch controls and safe areas.
- Expanded per-game settings and diagnostic tools to identify the causes of stalls more precisely.

## 🎨 Skins and touch controls

- Added **GameCube Pocket, Wii Pocket and PS2 Pocket** skins.
- Added **Pocket — Original** variants for GameCube, Wii and PS2 while keeping the existing designs.
- Added **Switch Pocket**, available through **Skins in the Switch playlist menu**.
- Portrait and landscape layouts, with orientation locking where supported by the selected skin and engine.
- Corrected offsets between the drawn buttons and their touch areas.
- Corrected **rectangular press highlights**, pressed states and analog-stick geometry.
- GameCube/Wii analog sticks now move as a complete circle, including the C-stick.
- Bundled skin updates now refresh older installed copies while preserving your selections.
- Restored access to **Skins from the PS2 playlist**.
- Corrected the return from the MeloNX in-game menu so skin buttons and sticks regain input immediately.
- Improved game-screen framing inside Pocket skins, including rounded corners.
- Refined pressed-button visuals so controls sink into their housings rather than simply turning gray.
- Dolphin and PS2 floating session buttons no longer cover skin controls when the skin provides its own Menu button.

## 🏆 RetroAchievements

- Centralized sign-in and **Hardcore** settings.
- Corrected repeated sign-outs, credential persistence and migration of older accounts.
- Improved session ownership of notifications and progress, including external-display presentation.
- Achievement text follows the app language when the required Apple translation features are available.
- Improved game recognition, including **CHD and CSO**, with consistent identification in the library and during play.
- Clearer messages distinguish an unrecognized game from an unreadable file.

## 🧩 Cheats & Enhancements

- A unified **Cheats & Enhancements** page for each game.
- Access to compatible frame-rate, aspect-ratio, graphics and other available game patches.
- Improved activation, deactivation and restoration of original settings.
- **Corrected unintended Switch cheat activation** when the enable list was missing.
- Cheat state remains usable after the app container moves.
- RewindBox-generated cheat files now contain only the selected programs.

## 📚 Library, artwork and manuals

- Reworked 3D cases with more faithful proportions, relief, spines and backs.
- Editable back covers and nondestructive image correction.
- Artwork matching using the ROM’s actual game identifier.
- More reliable batch scraping with better preservation of existing media.
- Improved **French cover and manual** lookup with additional sources.
- Improved scan viewing and zoom.
- Lighter Switch discovery avoids reading entire game files on the main thread.

## ✨ Interface and navigation

- New **RewindBox Glacier** style with a reversible preset.
- Bundled offline system artwork.
- Corrections to margins, obscured titles, icon sizes and carousels.
- Corrections to system bubbles and the “⋯” menu.
- An **icons-only main navigation bar**, while retaining accessible names for VoiceOver.

## 🧪 Experimental renderer

- Added an **optional native Metal 4 renderer for RPCS3**. Vulkan/MoltenVK remains available and the selected renderer is preserved.

## Testing and known limits

The downloaded Build 721 IPA passed the recorded offline package, source/component identity and delivery checks. RPCS3 Core 919. Fresh Flutter, native and delivery-contract checks were executed for this delivery. The downloaded file matches the original private delivery byte for byte.

Automated tests and desktop benchmarks do not establish iPhone FPS, audio or gameplay improvements. The complete package has not been gameplay-validated on a physical iPhone. First-use shader compilation and game-specific issues may remain. Cheats and achievement support depend on the game, version and engine.

Long Hogwarts Legacy pauses and residual BO2 performance problems remain under investigation. This build retains automatic BO2/God of War III comparison windows; their removal belongs to a later build and is not included here.

Some faithful Pocket layouts have small touch targets or Dynamic Island overlap. Switch Pocket’s HOME and Capture controls are unavailable in this engine; MeloNX does not lock session orientation through the skin. The MeloNX Metal binary-archive prototype, Switch 2 experiment and RPCS3 comparison-only Cores are not included.

## Download and installation

Important: accounts now need your own Firebase project

SceneBox no longer connects to a shared Firebase project. Sign-in, profiles and sync between devices now run on a free Firebase project that you create and own. Your data stays in your own account, not mine.

- Guest mode still works without any setup. Everything is kept on the device.
- To sign in, tap Connect Firebase on the sign-in screen and import the GoogleService-Info.plist from your Firebase project (on Apple TV, type in the values). Step-by-step guide and the security rules: https://github.com/donbytyqi/scenebox#firebase-setup
- Accounts made on the old shared project don't carry over. Create a new account on your own project.
- Profile photos need Firebase Storage, which requires Google's Blaze plan (it has a free tier). Everything else works on the free Spark plan.

New

- Support SceneBox page in Settings, for anyone who wants to donate.

Fixes

- Downloading a second episode from a season pack works now. Before, every episode of a pack counted as the same download, so you had to delete the finished one before the next would start. (#9)
- Apple TV: Trakt lists open when you click them. (#10)
- Mac: signing in works on the unsigned build. macOS doesn't let unsigned apps use the Keychain, so the app keeps your sign-in session and any API keys you enter in a file inside its own sandbox container instead (readable only by your user account).

Still open

- A few people report that on iPhone the app closes shortly after a stream starts buffering. I can't reproduce it on the simulator or on Mac. If it hits you, please share the crash log: Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements > Analytics Data, look for a file starting with SceneBox, and attach it to the issue. Also say which iPhone and what you were playing (torrent or debrid, resolution). 1.0.2 doesn't have this problem if you need a fallback.
- Apple TV install failing in Sideloadly with "ApplicationVerificationFailed / Invalid file" on tvOS 26.6 (#8). The tvOS build is packaged exactly like 1.0.2 and passes Apple's bundle verification here, so this needs the full Sideloadly log: the "Invalid file" line names the file it choked on. Please paste that on the issue. Sideloadly also has known trouble with tvOS 26.4 and later (pairing), so try the latest Sideloadly first.

Important: this release is NOT signed. You have to allow it yourself.

Nothing here is signed with an Apple developer account and the Mac app is not notarized. macOS and iOS will refuse to open it until you explicitly allow it. This is expected, it's not broken.

Mac:

1. Open the dmg and drag SceneBox to Applications.
2. Open SceneBox. macOS will say it "could not verify" the app or that it's from an unidentified developer. Press Done (not Move to Trash).
3. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security and press "Open Anyway" next to SceneBox, then confirm.
4. From then on it opens normally.

If you'd rather skip the dialog, run this in Terminal after copying the app to Applications:

    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/SceneBox.app

If you had an older signed version installed, delete it first.

iPhone/iPad: the ipa isn't signed, you sign it yourself with Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore, Feather or ESign with your own Apple ID. Free Apple ID = resign every 7 days (AltStore/SideStore do it for you), paid dev account = one year.

Apple TV: Sideloadly works over Wi-Fi. On the TV go to Settings > Remotes and Devices > Remote App and Devices so it shows up, then pick it in Sideloadly.

apps.name: Tsumiru
apps.subtitle: Native manga & manhwa reader for Suwayomi-Server
apps.localizedDescription: Tsumiru is a native client for reading manga & manhwa from a Suwayomi-Server instance, built for long webtoon binges. Offline downloads with an on-device catalog, a rebuilt continuous-scroll webtoon reader, incognito mode, and 13 built-in themes.

versions.localizedDescription:
A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

- Added **Per-category settings for sort and filters** to the Library, including changes made offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Added notifications when a new Tsumiru or server version is out, with **Remind later** and **Ignore** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Offset double spreads** to the paged reader for spreads that start on an odd page (@PainTownblue)

### ⚙️ Changes

- Made long strip taps and keys scroll by **Scroll distance** instead of a whole page (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed **Keep screen on** to off by default (@aaronbamblett)
- Added Up and Down page turns in horizontal paged mode and N and P to change chapter (@aaronbamblett)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Hid empty category tabs while searching or filtering the library, with **Show empty categories during search/filtering** to keep them (@aaronbamblett)
- Moved **Create registration code** to **Manage users** and added an **Edit** button to user rows (@aaronbamblett)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed the offline library not opening when Tsumiru starts without a connection (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Something went wrong** showing on every page while reading offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed library covers going blank in Safari after scrolling them off screen and back (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the paged reader restoring an old zoom when you return to a page (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed saved searches from older WebUI versions not loading (@aaronbamblett)

*Thanks to our Weblate translators: Damien O'Neil for French, Kisnov for Catalan, Andrei Stepanov for Russian and PainTownblue for Chinese.*

## Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See [Getting started](https://tsumiru.app/docs/guides/getting-started).

### Mobile

**Android:** download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

**iOS:** the `…-ios.ipa` below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add `https://tsumiru.app/apps.json` as a source in [SideStore](https://sidestore.io/) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io/) to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

- **[SideStore](https://sidestore.io/)** signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
- **[AltStore](https://altstore.io/)** expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
- **[TrollStore](https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-trollstore/)** installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

### Desktop

**Windows:** download `…-windows-x64.zip`, extract it anywhere, and run `tsumiru.exe`.

**macOS:** download `…-macos-universal.zip`, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

**Linux:** the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://flatpak.tsumiru.app/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru app.tsumiru.Tsumiru
```

Existing Flatpak installs keep receiving updates under `io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru`; no data, settings or logins move. AppImage/deb also keep that ID.

For a portable option, download `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### Web

Download `…-web.zip` and serve its contents with any static web server.

[Full documentation](https://tsumiru.app/)

apps.name: UTM
apps.subtitle: Virtual machines for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
UTM is a full featured virtual machine host for iOS. In short, it allows you to run Windows, Android, and more on your iPhone and iPad.

This version requires using AltJIT. Install UTM SE for slower emulation without JIT.

More information at https://getutm.app/

Features:

• Emulate any Processor
30+ processors supported by qemu including x86_64, ARM64, and RISC-V
• Run any Operating System
Windows, Linux, and more natively and securely on iOS within an App
• Fast Emulation
Para-virtualization with SPICE and JIT compilation with TCG
• High Compatibility
iOS 14+ supported. Works on iPhone and iPad. No jailbreak needed
• Free and Open Source
UTM and its dependencies are all free and open source
• Easy to Use
Configure and customize your VM in a native UI

versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (macOS) **Smoother displays**: VMs now follow your display's refresh rate, so motion is fluid at up to 120 Hz on ProMotion displays.
* **More reliable USB**: Fast external SSDs can now be shared with a VM, and disconnecting a drive no longer freezes UTM. On macOS, drives are safely unmounted before they are handed to a VM.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* (macOS) Check out [UTM Games Database](https://db.getutm.app/) to see and report game compatibility for the experimental 3D driver. Re-install the Windows guest tools to get the latest driver.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.
* SCSI drives on ARM64 virtual machines now use a VirtIO SCSI controller. A VM with a SCSI drive that was suspended, or has a snapshot with saved state, from an earlier version cannot resume it: delete the saved state and start the VM again.

## Issues
Please check the full list on [Github](https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/issues) and help report any bug you find that is not listed.

## Installation

* [iOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/ios/)
* [macOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/macos/)

| File | Description | Installation | JIT | Hypervisor | USB |
|------|------------|--------------|-----|-----------|-----|
| UTM.deb | Jailbroken iOS version | Open in Cydia, dpkg, or Sileo | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM.dmg | macOS version | Mounting and copying UTM.app to /Applications | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| UTM.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, etc (see guide) | Yes(2) | No | No |

1. Hypervisor on iOS requires an M1 iPad or newer.
2. Enabling JIT may require a separate JIT enabler such as [Jitterbug][2] or Jitstreamer.

### Verification (macOS)

The macOS release (`UTM.dmg`) is notarized by Apple. To verify the download, run `xcrun stapler validate UTM.dmg`. To verify the install, run `spctl -a -vv /Applications/UTM.app` and check that it is notarized and signed by `Turing Software, LLC (WDNLXAD4W8)`. This needs a network connection, so it cannot run from a sandbox that blocks outgoing connections.

[1]: https://getutm.app/install/
[2]: https://github.com/osy/Jitterbug

apps.name: VeneraNext
apps.subtitle: 跨平台漫画阅读器
apps.localizedDescription: 基于 Flutter 的跨平台漫画阅读器，支持本地漫画、WebDAV 漫画源与第三方网络漫画源，支持 Android、iOS、Windows、Linux、macOS 平台。

versions.localizedDescription:
### 正式版与升级

- 发布正式版 `1.18.3+249`，集中交付收藏操作、目录导航、归档兼容和依赖解耦后的构建，运行时代码沿用已验收的 RC3。Android 手机／TV、Windows、macOS、iOS、Linux x64／ARM64 与鸿蒙从同一正式版提交重新构建；保留历史标签，不复用或重命名候选安装包。
- 稳定更新渠道推进至本版；AltStore 与 Winget 元数据依据实际公开安装包更新，Winget 公共源收录需等待 Microsoft 审核。iOS IPA 与鸿蒙 HAP 仍需自行签名侧载。
- 升级前导出并另存完整应用数据备份，保留原漫画文件。共享 WebDAV 数据的设备统一使用兼容版本；回退使用升级前的备份，不让旧版覆盖新版收藏库。覆盖升级保留原数据，无需清库或重新导入。

### 鸿蒙随版分发

- 正式版继续包含同版本的鸿蒙 ARM64 未签名测试版 HAP、`harmonyos-manifest.json`、`harmonyos-SHA256SUMS` 和中英文安装指南。应用源码与平台适配统一在 `main`；普通平台使用官方 Flutter 和根锁，鸿蒙使用独立固定 Flutter OH SDK、CPF 覆盖与受控锁模板。
- 鸿蒙应用为 `VeneraNext (HarmonyOS Beta)`，包名为 `com.github.cyrilpeng.veneranext.harmony`，最低／目标 SDK 为 API 26，版本为 `1.18.3`，构建号为 249。升级须沿用原签名身份／密钥，同一助手或账号不保证同一把密钥。
- 鸿蒙本地导入支持系统提供的目录选择、多选归档，以及带一层可选外部总目录的「漫画合集 ZIP」；结构有多本漫画／单本多章节歧义时由用户确认，取消不入库。目录仅复制导入，PDF 导入、系统分享及生物认证等限制见安装指南。
- 每次候选版与正式版均要求鸿蒙构建成功，准确源码、版本、原生库、资源和全部五项附件须通过生成资产、GitHub 草稿及公开资产核验；缺包或摘要不一致阻止整次发布。草稿按完整分页列表定位唯一标签，再按发布 ID 核验，发布源码与生成产物使用隔离目录。
- 鸿蒙继续标记未签名 Beta，manifest 保留 `signed: false` 和 `runtime_verified: false`。本轮没有鸿蒙真机；构建及资产审核不代表设备签装、阅读、真实数据迁移、覆盖升级或续签已经验收。

### 修复与改进

- 修复 Android 收藏侧栏关闭新建弹窗后不能连续新建的问题；支持收藏夹仅修改名称大小写，保留目录标识、层级、内容、网络关联和追更设置，失败完整回滚。新建与导入按 SQLite 的 ASCII 大小写规则识别重名，自动命名避开占用名称（#143）。
- 收藏子目录返回时先关闭弹窗、退出搜索或多选，再进入真实父目录；保存目录选择期间的返回正常处理。工具栏父目录路径可以点击跳转，窄屏提供上一级按钮，大字体保留完整名称提示；名称中的 `/` 不作为层级数据。保持两级限制及现有备份／同步格式（#123，PR #144）。
- 修复导航容器重建时替换封面转场控制器的问题，控制器与嵌套导航器共用生命周期，取消返回手势及移除导航器时清理悬浮层。这是已确认的生命周期路径修复，原 Android 偶发封面悬浮仍需新版复测（#129）。
- 新导入同时避开本地库和各收藏夹已占用的同类型漫画 ID，未选收藏夹的导入也不会误关联残留收藏。保留旧记录、原文件与双库原子提交；存储不可读时拒绝冒险复用 ID。
- 适配 `archive 4.6.0`，应用备份与 CBZ 的 Dart 解压显式校验 CRC、解压大小和目录完整性。损坏或截断的备份在替换活动数据前失败，保留原收藏、设置及正常重试能力。
- 从 ZIP 原始文件名字节识别未标记的 UTF-8 和 GBK 中文名称，保留标准 UTF-8、有效 Unicode Path 扩展和 CP437 回退；合法 Unicode 名称不再被二次猜测编码，仍执行原有路径安全校验。
- 官方滚动列表首次尚未通知页码边界时，像素滚动代理立即绑定唯一活动列表，修复早期读取滚动偏移没有客户端的问题；远距离跳页和双列表动画仍按当前几何归属处理。
- 鸿蒙更新说明可滚动，横屏大字体下完整显示同密钥覆盖升级提示；文件／目录临时副本、实际网络请求及取消继续按应用生命周期清理。

### 依赖与维护

- 依赖优先采用官方稳定版，其次固定官方完整 commit，仅保留必要本地补丁。滚动列表回归官方 `0.3.8`，InAppWebView 使用审核后的官方提交，Windows 单包保留实例所有权补丁；SQLite 更新至 `2.9.4`、shimmer_animation 至 `2.2.2+1`。
- 精确保留兼容的官方 `dynamic_color 1.8.1`、网格 `5.7.0` 和 `pdfrx 2.4.7`，本次不扩大 Flutter SDK 更新范围；更新 `crypto`、`image` 和 `archive` 的锁定版本，保持 Flutter Rust Bridge `2.11.1`。
- 必要补丁包与自编 `venera_native`／`venera_saf` 随项目管理，来源、许可证、完整摘要和退出条件纳入校验。PNG 使用官方 LodePNG 20241015，7z 使用 7-Zip 24.09 的已声明 C 解码子集；保留原有算法、版权和逐字节整数读取。
- SAF 保留 Android 文档路径、持久授权、64 位操作、句柄 generation、isolate 交接及关闭／取消清理；QuickJS 固定到 `f5a1f20` 的必要核心安全回移，保留 Map、TypedData、Promise、dispatch 和 port 契约。真实 Provider、原生内存安全、图片处理及反复退出继续作为 CI 门禁。
- Issue 入口按崩溃／启动、阅读性能、导入／数据、网络／WebDAV、界面／其他缺陷和功能建议分类；按情形要求脱敏日志或手动诊断，纯界面与建议使用截图和验收标准。自动检查维护分类与缺失信息提示，材料补齐后更新原提示，保留人工跟进状态。
- 发布元数据、更新日志和正式版验收文档同步至 `1.18.3+249`。主线发版尝试已合为一个提交，本次版本准备单独保留一个中文约定式提交；运行时代码与依赖锁保持已验证的候选内容。

### 已知范围与后续反馈

- #143 的连续新建／仅改大小写与 #129 的原 Android 偶发封面悬浮仍需原设备新版反馈；自动化通过和独立 Android 覆盖升级验证不等于所有设备症状已解决，发布不会自动关闭报告。
- #115 原 Android「导入成功但不可见」的完整根因仍在调查。已提供的设备信息和附件继续复用；新版若仍出现，只需补充实际导入结果、隐藏提示及重启前后变化，有具体新错误再提供必要脱敏片段。
- 收藏目录仍为两级；更深层级、选择器和跨层拖动继续跟进 #123。收藏夹右上角的排序仅操作该目录直接收藏的漫画；同级子目录可在收藏侧栏「排序」中选择父目录后调整，入口说明的完善继续跟进 #155。
- 鸿蒙设备签装、完整功能、真实数据升级及续签仍按实际使用反馈验收；#152 多选入口、#81 分卷 CBZ、#139 白边裁剪作为后续独立需求。

apps.name: VRCM
apps.subtitle: Bring your VRChat social life to your phone
apps.localizedDescription: VRCM is a cross-platform VRChat companion focused on social connection and convenience. Explore your social circles, remember time spent together, and move smoothly from shared links to worlds, interactions, and real-world meetups.

versions.localizedDescription:
## 新增

- Android 和 iOS 支持通过相机或相册扫描 VRChat 链接，图片包含多个二维码时可选择识别结果。
- 支持扫码审批 VRChat 设备登录，展示请求时间和来源地区；Android 新增扫一扫桌面快捷方式。
- 新增独立“我的二维码”页面，支持个人主页码、样式切换和分享卡片。
- 统计数据支持 SQLite 导入导出，可导入 VRCM 或 VRCX 数据库，预览导入内容并去重合并。
- 设置按账号安全、外观、通知、隐私与数据等分类，集中管理已保存账号的切换和登出。
- 好友动态新增名字和模型变更记录，并提供独立的模型筛选分类。

## 优化

- 群组房间支持邀请自己，世界详情加载来源房间，展开的房间卡片可打开房主主页。
- 资料编辑适配 VRChat 新接口，保存简介、社交链接和语言后同步刷新状态。

## 修复

- 后台登录会话失效时自动恢复，避免好友与动态更新长期中断。
- 修复玩家批量清理在列表刚加载完时点击无响应，以及登录续期后剩余请求中断的问题；避免迟到的续期通知覆盖已成功的语音开关状态。
- 修复 Android 大型统计快照读取、系统文件选择器导入和导出文件句柄释放问题。
- 应用内更新遇到包名或签名不匹配的 APK 时停止更新，避免继续换源重试。
- 修复 Windows 渐进背景模糊导致的卡死、群组代表状态跨资料页不同步，以及模型列表的平台支持标记错误。

****************

## New Features

- Scan VRChat links with the camera or from photos on Android and iOS, and choose a result when an image contains multiple QR codes.
- Approve VRChat device sign-ins by scanning a code, with the request time and source region shown; Android also adds a launcher shortcut to the scanner.
- Added a separate My QR Code page with a profile code, appearance options, and a shareable card.
- Import and export statistics as SQLite files, with support for VRCM and VRCX databases, an import preview, and duplicate merging.
- Settings are organized into account security, appearance, notifications, privacy and data, and other categories, with saved-account switching and sign-out in one place.
- Friend activity now includes display-name and avatar changes, with a dedicated avatar filter.

## Optimizations

- Invite yourself to group instances, load the source instance in world details, and open the owner's profile from an expanded instance card.
- Profile editing follows VRChat's updated API and refreshes the saved bio, social links, and languages consistently.

## Bug Fixes

- Automatically restore expired background sessions to resume friend and activity updates.
- Fixed bulk player cleanup ignoring clicks just after loading or interrupting remaining requests after session renewal; delayed renewal notifications no longer overwrite successful mute or unmute actions.
- Fixed large statistics snapshots, imports through Android document providers, and file-handle cleanup after exports.
- In-app updates stop when an APK has a mismatched package name or signature instead of retrying other mirrors.
- Fixed Windows freezes caused by progressive backdrop blur, group representation falling out of sync across profiles, and incorrect platform-support indicators in avatar lists.

详情 / Details: <https://github.com/vrcm-team/VRCM/tree/main/docs/releases/1.1.6.md>

apps.localizedDescription: File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26 and 27, built on the worse_query sandbox technique. Browse other apps' containers, edit plists, hex and SQLite databases, and back up, restore or clear app data without a jailbreak or kernel exploit.

versions.localizedDescription:
> **Requires:** iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2, or iOS 27.0 up to 27.3 beta 1. **Not supported:** iOS 27.3 beta 2 and later, where Apple patched worse_query. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1, 27.3 beta 1 (confirmed by a user) and 26.7.1; see [Tested devices](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#tested-devices).
> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.

# Worse Query Files 0.9.18

Your own inspectors, your own cleaning targets, and Japanese.

## New

- **Custom inspectors** ([#45](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/45)): small JavaScript programs that show a file's contents your way. Long-press a file → **Open As → Custom Inspector…**. WQ Files ships only the runtime; the inspectors are yours.
  - **Install:** open a `.zip` holding an inspector with WQ Files (share sheet, AirDrop, Files app), or copy its folder into **Settings → Inspectors**. Installing one with the same name again updates it.
  - **Write one:** a folder with `manifest.json` and `inspect.js`. The script gets the file as bytes, as text and, for property lists, already parsed, and returns sections with rows or text. A `data.json` can hold your own lookup tables. Two examples and the full format are in the [README](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#custom-inspectors).
  - **Results:** tap a value to copy it; Share sends everything as text. Script errors show with their line number.
  - **Safe by design:** inspectors only read. A script has no access to other files, the network or the app, and is stopped after 2 seconds.
- **Your own folders and files in the Cache Cleaner:** long-press a folder or file inside an app's data → **Add to Cache Cleaner**. Instagram, for example, keeps uploaded videos in `Library/Application Support/Instagram/VideoUpload` long after they're posted.
  - Choose **Always Select** (selected after every scan and by Select All, like caches) or **Select by Hand** (you pick it each time). Long-press it in the Cache Cleaner to switch **Select Automatically** later, or to take it off the list.
  - A folder is emptied (the folder itself stays), a file is deleted.
  - Only add what the app can do without: anything it keeps there (drafts, downloads, logins) is gone once cleaned. The app's settings folders can't be added.
  - Saved per app, so it keeps working when the app moves to a new container.
